crossRefs.note: Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
In that day you will say, “Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name. Declare his doings among the peoples. Proclaim that…
Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”
to the assembly of God which is at Corinth—those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, with all who call…
hear in heaven, your dwelling place, and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you for; that all the peoples…
Now therefore, Yahweh our God, save us, I beg you, out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that…
That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,
Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.
Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.

translations.web: Oh give thanks to Yahweh. Call on his name. Make what he has done known among the peoples.
translations.bsb: “Give thanks to the LORD; call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.
translations.kjv: Give thanks unto the LORD, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.
translations.asv: O give thanks unto Jehovah, call upon his name; Make known his doings among the peoples.
